title: Fourth-root scale inequality
statement: For every integer $k\ge 0$ and every real number $\varepsilon\ge 0$, we have $(k\,9^k\varepsilon)^{1/4}\le 2^k\varepsilon^{1/4}$.
replaced: For every integer $k\ge0$ and real $\varepsilon\ge0$, the inequality $(k9^k\varepsilon)^{1/4}\le2^k\varepsilon^{1/4}$ holds.
